judge_rubric.name: logic_fidelity
judge_rubric.description: Does the mart reproduce the PowerCenter mapping: Filter keeps status='completed', Aggregator SUM(amount)->lifetime_amount and COUNT->order_count grouped per customer, and the Expression IIF(lifetime_amount>=200,'A','B') band?

judge_rubric.name: decomposition
judge_rubric.description: Is the Source Qualifier turned into a staging model and the mapping wired with ref()/source() through sensible staging->(intermediate)->mart layering rather than a monolith? Splitting related logic across multiple related intermediate models is good practice, not a fault - do not penalize extra intermediate models.

judge_rubric.name: test_quality
judge_rubric.description: Are there meaningful tests - unique/not_null on the customer_id grain and accepted_values on value_band (A/B) - not just trivially present?

judge_rubric.name: docs
judge_rubric.description: Is there a migration_changes.md and/or model descriptions mapping each PowerCenter transformation (Source Qualifier, Filter, Aggregator, Expression) to its dbt equivalent?
